name: Astro-Arc
author: Garrett McDaniel
description: Your birth chart and today's sky, painted as a new desktop every day in one of seven worlds, from Studio Ghibli to Edo woodblock to 1970s space art. It can also set your theme from the palette of each new background, daily or whenever you like. Runs from the Omarchy bar when you tell it to. Some of the images may strike a chord in your soul; we are not responsible if you get hooked. Uses an OpenAI API key, and works with any OpenAI model your key can reach.

barWidget.description: Daily wallpaper and theme from your birth chart
